newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares reach new highs in record trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares reach new highs in record trade.

text.p: Estonian shares rallied to fresh highs in record turnover on Tuesday as the appetite of local investors for options and forwards kept the market bubbling, dealers said.
Total trade on the main list was a record 277.5 million kroons as the Talse index gained a huge 4.51 percent to end at a new high of 449.94.
"We are still seeing locals buying and foreigners selling," one trader said.
"The locals have a lot of momentum because of the the big demand for options and forwards," he added.
Several smaller banks and Uhispank offer forwards while three of the biggest banks offer options trading in over-the-counter trades.
With local demand pushing up prices, foreigners see it as the best time to take their returns from the bourse, dealers said.
Dealers added that the market's immediate direction was unclear.
"It is difficult to say where the market will go as it is hard to buy the stock needed for hedging, but we are not expecting a crash," one trader said.
The market has spent the summer roaring to new highs with only brief bouts of profit-taking slowing the bulls.
Hansapank was the most active stock with 78.2 million kroons traded to close at a new high of 230 kroons, up 11 kroons.
Hoiupank turned over 54.9 million kroons to close at a new high of 310 kroons after a gain of 11 kroons.
On the free market total trade was 11.3 million kroons. Privatisation vouchers EVP.TL were the most active with 6.7 million kroons to rise to 0.429 kroons from 0.423 kroons.
